summary: Produced the backend design artefact for ADP-06 at src/design/adp-06-pipeline-run-correlation.md. The design defines additive correlation semantics for nullable audit.pipeline_run_id and event metadata propagation for pipeline-driven actions, with explicit null-compatible behavior for non-pipeline paths, cross-surface queryability contracts, migration/indexing guidance, ADP-09 compatibility constraints, and concrete testability notes.

tests_run.name: design completeness and acceptance traceability review
tests_run.detail: Verified required sections and explicit mapping to ADP-06 acceptance criteria, including additive schema/null behavior, write-path propagation rules, cross-surface queryability requirements, migration/indexing considerations, and compatibility links to OBS-03, ES-08, and ADP-09.
